# File-server freshness count leaks across Playwright groups

Owner: Sophie. This reaches every Engine PR's required unit job during the v14 cut.

## Context

The file-server freshness assertion received 2 instead of 1 on the [KeyNavigation unit job](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44954978789/job/137001030776), the [CLI unit job](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44951019313/job/136988773620), and [an earlier unit job](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44609064903/job/135860576972). The KeyNavigation job passed all seven new tests and failed its required check because CI rejects a flaky test.

## The Problem

`test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/fileServer.spec.mjs:279` expects one listening call for its current server. The observer is created at describe evaluation, so it survives reuse of the same Playwright worker. Each group runs `beforeAll` and starts a fresh server with that same observer.

## The Architectural Reality

Playwright groups tests with suite hooks using the global worker count. Its dispatcher separately enforces each project's worker cap and can reuse a compatible worker across groups. The fixture lifecycle belongs to the test file. The taken-port case also borrows the shared observer.

## The Fix

Create a fresh observer when `beforeAll` creates the suite server, and give the two servers in the taken-port test their own observers.

For a deterministic control, import the Engine unit config in a disposable config, set `workers: 2` and `retries: 0`, and add `workers: 1` to its unit project. Run just the file-server spec. This forces multiple groups to share one process. On `1af9f4622e`, the original fails with `Expected: 1, Received: 2` (17 passed). Per-server observers pass all 18 under the same schedule.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: The controlled worker-reuse run passes the freshness assertion and all 18 file-server cases.
- [ ] AC-2: The suite server and the taken-port servers each receive their own observer, and the diff is confined to the existing file-server spec.

## Out of Scope

Production file serving and CI worker configuration.

## Related

#21215 introduced the file-server coverage. #21828 and #21834 carry hosted failure evidence. #21033 tracks the v14 cut.
